title: 美议员警告：政策风险或波及加勒比稳定
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We're going to bring a member of Congress, that's Jonathan Jackson, he's the representative of the first congressional district in Illinois, service on the Foreign Affairs and Agriculture Committees in Congress.
segments.zh: 我们将请来一位国会议员，乔纳森·杰克逊，他是伊利诺伊州第一国会选区的代表，在国会外交事务和农业委员会任职。

segments.en: Great to have his perspective on this Sunday morning Congress, and thank you very much for being here.
segments.zh: 很高兴在这个周日上午听到他的观点，非常感谢您的到来。

segments.en: We were talking about kind of domestic matters through the prism of what's happening in Washington, D.C.
segments.zh: 我们刚才在讨论国内事务，从华盛顿特区的角度来谈。

segments.en: might have heard us talking about the fight over Todd Blanche's nomination before that we were talking about this reflecting pool, and maybe we can start there, not in the remit of Foreign
segments.zh: 您可能听到我们讨论托德·布兰奇提名的争议，之前我们谈到了那个倒影池，也许我们可以从这里开始，虽然这不属于外交或农业事务。

segments.en: Affairs or Agriculture, but one I know that you have strong opinions about.
segments.zh: 但我知道您对此有强烈的看法。

segments.en: Our sense of sort of what's transpired here over the last 72 hours, say, we had the U.S. attorney for the Columbia walking back in indictment that she'd put against a former Olympian who
segments.zh: 我们对过去72小时发生的事情的看法是，哥伦比亚特区联邦检察官撤回了对一名前奥运选手的起诉，该选手被指控破坏那个倒影池。

segments.en: was accused of vandalizing that reflecting pool, and now overnight the press and saying, no, in fact, that's not the case.
segments.zh: 但昨晚媒体又说，事实并非如此。

segments.en: He still believes that this was vandalism at play, and presumably that this individual still needs to be prosecuted.
segments.zh: 他仍然认为这是破坏行为，并且可能认为这个人仍然需要被起诉。

segments.en: Your reaction to that is somebody whose gaze I know is out on the national mall and at the reflecting pool from time to time during the course of a week.
segments.zh: 您的反应是什么？我知道您每周都会时不时关注国家广场和倒影池。

segments.en: That's funny. That's good. This is just awful, that the president obviously needs some help.
segments.zh: 有趣。这太糟糕了，总统显然需要一些帮助。

segments.en: He's being ill-advised and ill-served by the people that are closest to him.
segments.zh: 他身边的人给他出了馊主意，让他误入歧途。

segments.en: And to tell you, I don't know where the money's coming from, it's not being appropriated by Congress.
segments.zh: 坦白说，我不知道钱从哪来，国会并没有拨款。

segments.en: I don't know where the gold leaf on the statues is coming from, where this nobid contract comes from, for a convicted felon that was engaged in bribery with elected officials.
segments.zh: 我不知道雕像上的金箔从哪来，也不知道那份给被判有罪且曾贿赂官员者的无竞标合同从何而来。
